title: boryangraecum ochraceum
intro: Boryangraecum ochraceum, commonly known as the Korean licorice vine, is a plant species native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, due to its health benefits in soothing stomach ulcers, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Boryangraecum ochraceum include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating infections, pain, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
